name: 02852 · N Kingstown, RI
findings: ZIP 02852 (N Kingstown) has 113 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02852 (N Kingstown) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02852 (N Kingstown) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 36 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
